snippet.title: Yars Rising - Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Yars Rising is out now! Join Emi Kimura as she runs, jumps, sneaks, and hacks her way through the hallways of mega-corporation, QoTech. Unlock new biohacks and abilities to grow stronger and take down the powerful enemies in your way. Are you ready to hack your destiny? 

Play Yars Rising: https://urals.co/atari/yars-rising

Join the conversation on Discord: https://discord.gg/atariclub
